rv.q: But even by those vaunted historical standards, “Port of Entry” is an astonishing piece of work; the actors are simply wonderful, but you are most likely to leave thinking about and still feeling the pulse of this physical environment.
The humanity, wit and open-hearted hope instilled in the immigrant stories within this production shine through.
Port of Entry gives us the gift of being able to hear them up close, and making us see that we're not bystanders, but fellow pilgrims.
Let yourself be one of the guests and allow these people to share their lives with you.

cn.t: An immersive exploration of immigrant experiences in Chicago's Albany Park earns praise for its evocative storytelling and innovative use of space, though it upends traditional theatrical conventions.
